projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of academic and personal work demonstrating my technical capabilities.

items.title: Electricity Price Forecasting with Statistical, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning Models
items.description: Electricity price forecasting project using temporal, meteorological data and advanced predictive models.
items.objective: Compare statistical, machine learning, and deep learning models to predict hourly electricity prices.
items.problem: Reduces uncertainty associated with electricity price volatility in liberalized energy markets.
items.value: Integrates time series analysis, advanced models, and robust metrics in a structured CRISP-DM approach.

items.title: Analysis and Application of Machine Learning Techniques to Music Data
items.description: Application of machine learning methods to music data for regression, classification, and feature selection.
items.objective: Analyze, model, and compare machine learning algorithms applied to music popularity and classes.
items.problem: Music popularity prediction and track classification using complex audio features and imbalanced data.
items.value: Integrates regression, classification, cross-validation, and regularization, demonstrating best practices in applied machine learning.

items.title: WALIT – Subscription and Shared Expense Management
items.description: Mobile application for managing subscriptions and shared expenses, with automatic notifications and centralized financial overview.
items.objective: Help users control subscriptions and shared expenses in a simple, centralized, and automatic way.
items.problem: Lack of control, visibility, and organization of subscriptions and recurring expenses in shared environments.
items.value: Implements a secure and modular backend architecture with JWT authentication, centralized financial logic, and scalability ready for evolution.

items.title: Polyglot Persistence – Urban Transportation System
items.description: Intelligent transport system integrating PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Neo4j to manage complex and heterogeneous data.
items.objective: Create a modular architecture (React and Node.js) for public transport, focused on scalability, performance, and polyglot persistence.
items.problem: Overcomes limitations of traditional relational systems, enabling management of large volumes of varied data with necessary flexibility.
items.value: Optimizes storage using ideal technology: PostgreSQL (critical), MongoDB (flexible), Redis (cache), and Neo4j (routes).

items.title: REST API for Inventory Management
items.description: Complete RESTful API for inventory management with authentication, documentation, and testing.
items.objective: Develop a robust and well-documented API following development best practices.
items.problem: Need for a scalable and secure backend for stock management applications.
items.value: Implements REST standards, JWT authentication, Swagger documentation, and automated testing.

items.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Interactive dashboard for real-time sales data visualization and analysis.
items.objective: Create interactive visualizations that allow intuitive exploration of business metrics.
items.problem: Difficulty extracting actionable insights from large volumes of sales data.
items.value: Combines automated ETL, interactive visualizations, and real-time KPIs.
